newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - July 15.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - July 15.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page Tuesday:
* The dollar surged in value Monday against most major European currencies, reaching its highest level in six years against the German mark and the French franc.
* Aids deaths continue to decline in the U.S. and the trend is expected to go on.

* The administrations of President Clinton and New York Governor George Pataki reached an agreement that would for the first time require most of New York's 3.5 million Medicaid recipients to enroll in managed care plans.
* Days away from a vital mission to repair the stricken Mir space station, the Russian commander said he was having heartbeat irregularities.
* Western-style capitalism is coming to Tokyo, upsetting a way of life.
* Republicans are winning elections in the traditionally Democratic New Mexico.
